data.title: 空门苍 · 后山树荫下的肩膀借宿
data.description: 漫步在前往灯塔的林荫小道上，走着走着苍的步调就慢了下来。她自然而然地靠上身旁人的肩膀，微热的脸颊贴着衣料，任由海风撩起校服的领结。
data.location: narrow cobblestone island path through lush coastal forest toward lighthouse
data.action: walking side-by-side then slowing down, resting her head comfortably against partner shoulder with half-closed drowsy eyes and a fond smile
data.lighting: soft sea breeze rustling green leaves casting moving shadows over school sweater vest
data.mood: gentle domestic reliance, comfortable trusting romance, sweet peaceful bond
data.promptProse: Resting her sleepy head against partner shoulder along a shaded island path, Ao walks slowly with contented half-closed eyes and fluttering tie.
data.animaCaption: Ao leaning her sleepy head on her partner shoulder along a lush island path.
